address: Banyan Tree Dubai, Bluewaters Island, Dubai
bio: The eponymous celebrity chef brings his fun, bold style of cooking to Banyan Tree Hotel, where service is sweet and attentive, and the generous dishes are ideal for sharing. The fun, extensive menu offers Chinese classics with an original twist. We suggest starting with their salt and pepper tofu, then try out their lobster with green onions and ginger and finish off with a chocolate matcha fondant with brown rice ice cream....
